newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes up against US dollar.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes up against US dollar.

text.p: The Chinese yuan ended up at 8.3025 against the U.S. dollar on Wednesday from Tuesday's 8.3030 on the Shanghai-based interbank foreign exchange market on strong pro-yuan sentiment.

The yuan opened up at 8.3025 and consolidated around that level for most of the session, hitting an intra-day high of 8.3018 and a low of 8.3032. Trading was active early but dull late in the session, with most done at 8.3025, traders said.
Dealers said that intervention by the central bank before the close on Tuesday did not change strong pro-yuan sentiment but only slowed the yuan's rise.
"Bids were still strong at lower levels and the yuan ended its fall on Tuesday," said one dealer.
Dealers expect the yuan to move in a range of 8.3020 and 8.3030 on Thursday.
The yuan ended up at 7.5710 from 7.5825 against 100 Japanese yen and slightly up at 1.0730 from 1.0734 against the Hong Kong dollar.
